intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Irvine for 2026, and here is what he found: 14 family events. The magic runs through January 3, 2027 (Ice Skating at Irvine Spectrum Center), with Dream Glow Festival at Wild Rivers Waterpark (through December 30) and Festival Ballet Theatre's The Nutcracker at the Irvine Barclay Theatre (December 5 to 24) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
